The PNG fixtures are synthetic vertical color gradients with no user data or external artwork. `preview-landscape.png` is 6000 × 4000 pixels (24 MP, colors #102a40 to #24a6a0); `preview-portrait.png` is 1200 × 2400 pixels (colors #402010 to #c4a060). They were generated once with ImageMagick `convert -size WIDTHxHEIGHT gradient:'COLOR1-COLOR2' -strip OUTPUT.png`. Smoke tests read the committed bytes and require no image processing tool. Together they exercise large browser-decoded images and both orientations without real attachments.
